description: Deadline to answer a pay information request from a worker (individual pay level and average pay by sex for the same work or work of equal value) or an applicant: the due date under the jurisdiction's rule, any escalation or offence dates and the official source. The period runs from the date the rule's text names (receipt, or the day the request is made); periodStart.statement says which date was used and any assumption. Where the text does not state calendar or working days, both counts are returned. Not for: what the answer must cover (pay_request_reply_outline), or deadlines of other HR procedures.

employer_headcount.description: Number of employees (staff, workforce size) of the employer.

jurisdiction.description: Country, US state or Canadian province code from list_jurisdictions, e.g. AT (Austria), IT (Italy), MT (Malta), PL (Poland), SK (Slovakia), US-CA (California), US-NY (New York), CA-ON (Ontario).

made_on.description: Date the request was made (YYYY-MM-DD), if earlier than the date it was received. Where the rule counts from the day the request is made, or does not say, leaving it out means the request is taken as made on the day it was received (the result says so).

received_on.description: Date the employer received the pay information request (YYYY-MM-DD).

requester_type.description: Who asked: worker (employee), applicant (job candidate) or workers_representative.

name: pay_request_deadline
title: Pay-request deadline
